title: Practice 2: «For a while»: по- and про-

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What else could I have done?
exercises.why: **поделать** — поде́лать (perfective): to make, to do (for a while). Wiktionary: по- + де́лать.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to carry (for a while; on foot)
to run past, to run through
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: приподня́ть — to raise, to lift (a little); понести́ — to carry (for a while; on foot); почита́ть — to read (for a while); пробежа́ть — to run past, to run through.
**простоял** — простоя́ть (perfective): to stand, to stay (for some time); to stand idle; to stand, to remain (of buildings). Wiktionary: про- + стоя́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: He stood in line for an hour.
exercises.why: **простоял** — простоя́ть (perfective): to stand, to stay (for some time); to stand idle; to stand, to remain (of buildings). Wiktionary: про- + стоя́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: I'm going to look for them.
exercises.why: **поищу** — поиска́ть (perfective): to look for, to search (for some time). Wiktionary: по- + иска́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поищем** — поиска́ть (perfective): to look for, to search (for some time). Wiktionary: по- + иска́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **поносит** — поноси́ть (perfective): (transitive) to carry something (for a while); (transitive) to wear clothes, to shoes (for a while). Wiktionary: по- + носи́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Do you want to wear my jacket?
exercises.why: **поносить** — поноси́ть (perfective): (transitive) to carry something (for a while); (transitive) to wear clothes, to shoes (for a while). Wiktionary: по- + носи́ть.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to make, to do (for a while)
to stand, to stay (for some time)
to look for, to search (for some time)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: поде́лать — to make, to do (for a while); пропе́ть — to sing; простоя́ть — to stand, to stay (for some time); поиска́ть — to look for, to search (for some time).
